name: all_in_1
description: Global visual + multi-model + media AI layer for OpenCode (P1 registries/roles/cost policy/project detection, P2 browser/screenshot/artifacts, P3 vision/model catalogue/capabilities/provider adapter validation, P4 execution layer/capability selection/egress security/live invocation, P5 specialist layer/HITL workflow orchestration/structured-output validation/observability, P6 OpenCode plugin binding/command surface/edit boundary)

scripts.desktop:build: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist/desktop', { recursive: true, force: true });" && esbuild desktop/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --outfile=dist/desktop/main.mjs && esbuild desktop/src/preload.cjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/desktop/preload.cjs
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:assets
